fields.summary: Component readiness: Explanations field serialized as null causes regressed tests modal crash
fields.description:
Opening the regressed tests modal on the component readiness page crashes with: can't access property "length", explanations is null in CompSeverityIcon.

h2. Root Cause

TestComparison structs are created with a nil Explanations slice in `component_report.go:616` and `test_details.go:442`. Several code paths in `assessComponentStatus` / `buildFisherExactTestStats` never append to Explanations (e.g. the "no regression" branch), so it stays nil. Go serializes nil slices as JSON `null`.

h2. Fix

Initialize `Explanations: []string{}` at both TestComparison creation sites. A defensive `!= null` check was already added to `CompSeverityIcon.js:22`.

h2. Files

* `pkg/api/componentreadiness/component_report.go:616`
* `pkg/api/componentreadiness/test_details.go:442`
* `sippy-ng/src/component_readiness/CompSeverityIcon.js:22`
